image_description: A close-up, high-angle view of a modern outdoor staircase featuring a stainless steel bannister system. The handrail is tubular and metallic, supported by vertical cylindrical posts attached to the side of concrete steps with textured anti-slip nosing. In the background, there is a brick retaining wall, some green vegetation, and the lower portion of a white building facade.
